title: Create fedi-integrity crate: signed AP objects
description:
Standalone crate for signing and verifying ActivityPub objects using Linked Data Integrity proofs (FEP-8b32).

Backwards-compatible: adds a 'proof' field to Note/Create objects. Existing AP servers ignore it. Aware servers can verify authenticity even after the origin server dies or detect tampering by relays.

Public API:
- sign_object(object: &mut serde_json::Value, private_key: &[u8; 32], did_key: &str) -> Result<()>
  Adds a 'proof' field to the JSON object containing:
  - type: Ed25519Signature2020
  - verificationMethod: the did:key URI
  - created: ISO 8601 timestamp
  - proofValue: multibase-encoded Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON (JCS - RFC 8785)
  
- verify_object(object: &serde_json::Value, public_key: &[u8; 32]) -> Result<ProofStatus>
  Extracts proof field, reconstructs canonical JSON (minus proof), verifies signature.
  Returns ProofStatus { valid: bool, signer_did: String, signed_at: String }

- strip_proof(object: &mut serde_json::Value) -> Option<serde_json::Value>
  Remove proof field for canonical form computation.

- ProofStatus struct with verification result metadata.

Canonicalization: Use JCS (JSON Canonicalization Scheme, RFC 8785) — deterministic JSON serialization. This is critical: the same object must produce the same bytes regardless of key ordering.

Integration with fedi-did: uses ed25519_to_did_key() for verificationMethod URI, ed25519-dalek for signing/verification. The signing key is the same recovery key from generate_recovery_keypair().

AP integration point: add proof to Note objects before delivery. On receipt, if proof field exists, verify it. Store verification status. Display verification badge on posts from verified actors.

Deps: ed25519-dalek, serde_json, fedi-did (for did:key encoding), multibase.

Spec references: 
- FEP-8b32: Object Integrity Proofs
- W3C Data Integrity (formerly Linked Data Proofs)
- RFC 8785: JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS)

Security notes:
- Proof covers the object content, not the wrapping Create activity
- Replay protection via 'created' timestamp in proof
- Must normalize JSON before signing (JCS) to prevent key-reordering attacks
- Signature is over bytes, not string — UTF-8 normalization matters
close_reason: fedi-integrity crate created: sign_object, verify_object, strip_proof, compute_sri_hash, verify_sri_hash. JCS canonicalization via fedi-did. 13 tests + doc-test.
